scope: Exact-SHA review of the v3 logging/privacy correction against the previously reviewed B02 plan and original source/evidence pins. Approval is for implementation and independent test authoring only; it is not acceptance, deployment, SSO, PostgreSQL production, B03, or AT-21 completion approval.

delta_review.previous_blocker: B02-PLAN-06: OIDC callback authorization code/state could appear in request/access logs.
delta_review.resolution: PASS. Uvicorn access_log is fixed false; HTTP request-line/query/body/header and HTTP client debug logging are disabled; callback code/state/error_description and session/CSRF material are covered by a static audit allowlist that permits only static event/code, server trace_id, and internal job/command identifiers. Raw redirect location, cookies, Authorization, CSRF, and callback exception details are excluded.
delta_review.independent_test: PASS. G3 now exercises successful, failed, expired, and replayed callbacks with synthetic code/state/error_description canaries and checks service stdout/stderr and application logs for their absence. Test canaries are not published as evidence values.
delta_review.proxy_boundary: PASS. Reverse-proxy query redaction remains a separate operational acceptance item; local application evidence is not represented as proxy proof.
delta_review.other_delta: No material change to the previously approved-by-review B02 contracts or phase matrix was found.
